design_name: Clean outcome-unseen TRI OER second-family neighboring-knowledge validation
status: file hash and outcome-free pickle schema verified; four paper-defined target sets and composition systems frozen; target fom bytes not decoded or inspected
replaces_for_confirmation: Caltech acid-OER target, which failed the outcome-free per-plate minimum and remains sensitivity-only
claim_guard: All four composition sets and every source/control remain in the denominator. This clean target can validate or reject the second-family edge; it cannot be replaced after target access.

target_record.allowed_metadata: pickle opcode/schema inspection found comp, fom, sno, and runint arrays; fom raw bytes were not decoded; the official paper defines the four confirmatory plate IDs and element order

target.entity: composition-set identifier plus row identifier and normalized composition
target.primary_outcome: fom: negative OER overpotential at 3 mA cm-2
target.direction: maximize, as specified by the official paper
target.outer_unit: one of the four dataset/plate identifiers
target.components: outcome-free composition clusters within and across sets
representations: element fractions plus any outcome-free process/context array present in every set
target.excluded_pickle_set: 3875 is present in the deposited pickle but absent from the official paper's Table 1 four-dataset benchmark; it is excluded before fom decoding

same_reaction_reference.role: same OER reference; full source use is allowed only after acid target is formally downgraded

prediction.primary_endpoint: paired relative RMSE reduction on the held-out set and its highest outcome-free OOD quartile
prediction.absolute_gate: positive augmented-model R2 on held-out set

co_primary: acquisitions to first distinct top-5-percent cluster

hypothesis_cards.timing: after outcome-free target metadata and source ranks but before target fom access
hypothesis_cards.minimum: one same-OER card, one adjacent-reaction card, and one consensus/complementarity card

inference.unit: held-out composition set and composition cluster
inference.within_target: paired set/cluster bootstrap and source-rank randomization with Holm correction
inference.across_targets: random-effects synthesis with Starrydata target-level effect and between-target heterogeneity; target-level effects remain visible
